column2: Character portrait for a children's strategy game guide, painterly gouache style matching a children's encyclopedia, warm soft light, the same character in every picture: a round friendly brown owl with large amber eyes, small round brass spectacles, cream feathered belly, ear tufts, holding an old leather-bound memory book with a ribbon, sitting on a wooden branch. Square 1:1, the owl fills most of the frame, simple warm dark brown background with a soft vignette, no text, no letters, no logos. The owl explains something calmly, one wing raised like a teacher pointing at an idea, a gentle knowing smile.
